core_obligations: Identify the extreme relative cohomology sheaves using the relative Hodge-to-de Rham spectral sequence, the vanishing of the relative differentials above degree $n$, the vanishing of the higher direct images above the fibre dimension and the degeneration of the bottom and top parts, and choose the trace map through the relative Hodge duality lemma (proof lines 6340-6364).

Show that the wedge map on $\operatorname{Tot}(\Omega^\bullet \otimes_{f^{-1}\mathcal{O}_S} \Omega^\bullet)$ annihilates the indicated subcomplex for degree reasons, so that it factors through maps $\gamma_p$ from the truncated total complex, and obtain the relative cup products between $Rf_*\sigma_{\leq p}\Omega^\bullet$ and $Rf_*\sigma_{\geq n-p}\Omega^\bullet$ (proof lines 6366-6396).

State the induction on $p$: the case $p = n$ is the proposition and the base case $p = 0$ reduces to the relative Hodge duality pairing, using the identifications $Rf_*\sigma_{\leq 0}\Omega^\bullet = Rf_*\mathcal{O}_X$ and $Rf_*\sigma_{\geq n}\Omega^\bullet[2n] = Rf_*\Omega^n[n]$ (proof lines 6397-6412).

Perform the induction step with the two distinguished triangles relating $\sigma_{\leq p+1}$ to $\sigma_{\leq p}$ and $\sigma_{\geq n-p-1}$ to $\sigma_{\geq n-p}$, and their images under $Rf_*$; the compatibility of the four pairs of maps turns the setup into a map from one triangle to the dual of the other, so that the outer perfect pairings and the third-isomorphism lemma give perfectness in the middle (proof lines 6414-6466).

Define compatibility of two pairings under maps $e : K \to K'$ and $e' : M' \to M$ by the commutativity of the displayed square, and note that it is exactly the commutativity of the diagram expressing the pairings as maps into $R\mathcal{H}om(-, \mathcal{O}_S)$ (proof lines 6468-6491).

Verify compatibility for the three cases through the commutative diagrams: the pair $(c,c')$ using functoriality of the cup product with $\gamma_p$ and $\gamma_{p+1}$, the pair $(b,b')$ with the wedge on the degree $p+1$ part, and the pairs $(d,d')$ and $(a,a')$ with the remaining square (proof lines 6493-6537).
Record that the uniqueness of $t$ up to precomposition with a unit of $H^0(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ is left to the reader (proof lines 6539-6541).

difficulty_reason: The proposition is the relative form of Poincare duality: for a proper smooth morphism with nonempty equidimensional fibres of dimension $n$ there is a trace map on the top relative de Rham sheaf, unique up to a unit of the structure sheaf's global sections, making the derived pairing on $Rf_*\Omega^\bullet_{X/S}$ a perfect pairing of perfect complexes on the base (statement lines 6317-6337). The proof transplants the absolute argument to the relative setting: it identifies the extreme relative cohomology sheaves through the relative Hodge-to-de Rham degeneration, builds the pairings from restrictions of the wedge product, and runs the same induction on the truncation parameter, but replaces the five-lemma step by a triangulated third-isomorphism argument and verifies compatibility of four pairs of maps through three commutative diagrams; uniqueness is again left to the reader. The relative bookkeeping with the derived category argument is the substance, so the claim is H3.
